runners_data.name: Amigos Legacy
runners_data.comment: Stable much respected at this venue, but not typically associated with juvenile winners
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; gelded son of Earthlight; dam; by Iffraaj, unplaced, half-sister to winners including the useful Barenboim (six races) and, Ambiente Amigo (1m2f Listed); respected stable, but not typically associated with juvenile winners.

runners_data.name: Litmus Test
runners_data.comment: Cost 160,000gns as a yearling, half-brother by Havana Grey to winners, top stable
runners_data.spotlight: 160,000gns Y; fourth foal; half-brother by Havana Grey to winners Niigata (1m2f AW; RPR 84) and Maremma (Swedish 6f/1m); dam 6f winner (64), sister to 7f Listed winner Intense Pink, out of half-sister to 6f Listed winner Paradise Isle.

runners_data.name: New Yorker
runners_data.comment: By No Nay Never, second foal out of dual Group 1 winner Fairyland, of automatic interest
runners_data.spotlight: No Nay Never colt is the second foal out of the Lowther/Cheveley Park/Flying Five winner Fairyland; dam (by Kodiac) a sister to useful 5f/6f winner Atletico, half-sister to Australian 7f Group 2 winner Now Or Never, out of unraced half-sister to  Group 1 winner Dream Ahead.

runners_data.name: Ranting Duke
runners_data.comment: £35,000 yearling; third foal, dam Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner, others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: £35,000 Y; third foal; dam Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner (RPR 91), closely related to 6f winner Hightime Heroine, half-sister to Listed winners Redolent (1m) and Pepita (7f), out of 1m winner.

runners_data.name: Matriarchal
runners_data.comment: Half-sister by Sioux Nation to winners in Australia and I dam won in France
runners_data.spotlight: A 45,000gns yearling buyback; fourth foal; half-sister by Sioux Nation to winners in Australia and Italy; dam French winner, half-sister to Group 2 winner Loxley.

runners_data.name: Blixen Force
runners_data.comment: Beaten favourite when third in Brocklesby, experience gained then could be decisive
runners_data.spotlight: E30,000 foal, £110,000 yearling; February foal by Persian Force; beaten favourite when third in Brocklesby; winner and second supplied by Richard Hannon and Ralph Beckett respectively; hung right when challenging; promising run all the same, experience could be decisive.

runners_data.name: Belle Island
runners_data.comment: Beaten a shade over 4l when second here on debut, open to improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to four winners; dam 5f 2yo winner; beaten a shade over 4l when second here on debut two weeks ago; open to improvement.

runners_data.name: Oxford Circus
runners_data.comment: Narrow winner of a C&D maiden in February (lost race on a technicality) in rear on latest
runners_data.spotlight: Expensive yearling; unraced for the Crisfords, bought cheaply last October; narrow winner of a C&D maiden in February on third start; subsequently stripped of that victory due to her rider being deemed ineligible on a technicality; dropped away to finish in rear on handicap debut over C&D three weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Winemaker
runners_data.comment: Solid 7f run here two weeks ago, has a slight edge over Hot To Foxtrot
runners_data.spotlight: Recorded a fifth win (third on AW) when scoring over C&D in January off 5lb lower (has won off a mark of 72 before); hampered when attempting to follow up over 7f next time, finishing 2 1/2l fourth; not at his best back on turf at the Curragh before another solid 7f run here two weeks ago.

runners_data.name: An Laochmor
runners_data.comment: Won 5f Lingfield handicap in February, backed that up here nine days ago, leading chance
runners_data.spotlight: Now 13lb higher than when fourth behind Winemaker here in January on stable debut; belatedly off the mark (17th outing) when landing the odds in a low-grade 5f Lingfield handicap in February; backed that up when favourite for a 5f contest nine days ago.

runners_data.name: Sovereign Banter
runners_data.comment: Third behind Winemaker here in January; stable in great form; can make his presence felt
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner last October, beating good yardstick Nikki Swango; has made the frame in four of his six subsequent races here, including two seconds; best of three 2026 runs when third behind Winemaker in January; stable's horses showing good form across a range of categories.

runners_data.name: Jered Maddox
runners_data.comment: Prolific winner at this venue, generally poor form before encouraging display last time
runners_data.spotlight: 12-86, including nine course wins (four over C&D); mark has dropped significantly since his last win in 2025; generally poor form, until an encouraging display in taking third over 5f here three weeks ago; rider reported he received a check in the final furlong.

runners_data.name: Son Of Wind
runners_data.comment: No sign of a revival in form when last of 14 on Irish debut over 7f here two weeks ago
runners_data.spotlight: 1-15; well enough handicapped on juvenile form when he achieved a peak rating of 70 based on consistent form at Chelmsford; regressive last season; no sign of a revival in form when last of 14 on Irish debut over 7f here two weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Rough Diamond
runners_data.comment: Has struggled in three 7f runs since joining John Carr after a spell in Britain
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner, five-time scorer in all; has struggled in three 7f runs since joining John Carr after a spell in Britain.

runners_data.name: Rattletheonionbag
runners_data.comment: A 30-race maiden; placed in six of her 17 races at this venue, uninspiring form lately
runners_data.spotlight: A 30-race maiden; placed in six of her 17 races at this venue; generally uninspiring form lately, although could be given some sort of chance on her third placing over C&D three starts ago.

runners_data.name: Hot To Foxtrot
runners_data.comment: Much improved when fifth over 7f here a fortnight ago but has a bit to find with Winemaker
runners_data.spotlight: Very little mileage on the clock; definite promise in two of her maiden runs, the first of which was in 2023; three handicap attempts in 2025 were poor; much improved when fifth over 7f here a fortnight ago, but has a bit to find with third-placed Winemaker.

runners_data.name: Snowballs
runners_data.comment: Beaten 7l in seventh behind An Laochmor here nine days ago, unlikely to reverse form
runners_data.spotlight: Glimmers of promise in maidens but has struggled in three handicaps over 5f; made some late headway after starting slowly when beaten 7l in seventh behind An Laochmor here nine days ago.

runners_data.name: Cooee Call
runners_data.comment: Sixth of ten behind today's rival An Laochmor on stable debut last week, well held
runners_data.spotlight: Weak form for his previous trainer; marginally better when sixth of ten behind today's rival An Laochmor on stable debut here last week.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden

runners_data.name: Beach Barbie
runners_data.comment: Dam a 5f/6f winner for this stable, likely to find a few of her younger rivals too good
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth foal; by Footstepsinthesand out of Magic Bear, a 5f/6f winner (including at this venue) for this stable; dam is from the family that produced the trainer's Group 1-winning sprinter Slade Power; likely to find a few of her younger rivals too good.

runners_data.name: Coasting
runners_data.comment: Stablemate of the twice-placed Allsortz who is much more likely to feature
runners_data.spotlight: 20,000gns yearling; Bated Breath gelding is the first foal out of an Elusive Quality mare who ran once; stablemate of the twice-placed Allsortz who is much more likely to feature.

runners_data.name: Hinder
runners_data.comment: Half-sister to two high-class performers for this stable, good chance of a winning debut
runners_data.spotlight: Noteworthy as a half-sister by Expert Eye to Babouche (6f inc 2yo Group 1; RPR 117), Zarinsk (6f-1m inc 2yo/Group 2); half-sister to four others winners; dam 7f and 1m (Listed) winner (103).

runners_data.name: Real Encounter
runners_data.comment: Made the frame in maidens at Leopardstown and this venue last year, should feature now
runners_data.spotlight: A 150,000euros breeze-up buy; 16-1 on debut at Leopardstown, managed a fair fourth of 14 having been outpaced at a crucial stage; met some trouble in running when fourth behind the useful-looking Yellowstone Lake here in September; runner-up Emmeleia has franked the form here recently; should feature now.

runners_data.name: Aughlish
runners_data.comment: Got into the money here six weeks ago on debut, this race appears stronger
runners_data.spotlight: Got into the money (promoted to third) here six weeks ago on debut; this race appears stronger.

runners_data.name: Meriden
runners_data.comment: Failed to get into contention at the Curragh on debut, likely to need more experience
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to get into contention at the Curragh on debut; likely to need more experience.

runners_data.name: Allsortz
runners_data.comment: Placed over C&D on his last two starts, good form claims but possibly vulnerable
runners_data.spotlight: Best of five turf runs last season when fourth in a decent 6f Fairyhouse contest in June; handled this surface when a fair third over C&D in November; second here nine days ago; good form claims but vulnerable to a newcomer of Hinder's likely calibre.

runners_data.name: Atallah
runners_data.comment: Lost ground at the start and finished in the rear at Fairyhouse on only start last season
runners_data.spotlight: Lost ground at the start and finished in the rear at Fairyhouse on only start last season.

runners_data.name: Imperial Fighter
runners_data.comment: Two minor in Britain; failed to build on a second placing over 1m here in January
runners_data.spotlight: Two minor wins on the Flat in Britain; failed to build on a second placing over 1m here in January; best of four subsequent runs when fourth in a claimer; down the field over hurdles last time.

runners_data.name: Ferrari Desert
runners_data.comment: Much more effective here than on turf, potentially interesting after a recent Curragh run
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner in October 2024 and twice second here in the opening months of 2025; probably need the run here in January and should be close to peak fitness now after a recent Curragh run.

runners_data.name: Macadam's Rock
runners_data.comment: Four C&D wins, the latest in this race last year, a long way below best on last two visits
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time C&D winner, latest win 12 months ago; a long way below his best on last two visits.

runners_data.name: Will Be King
runners_data.comment: Returned from a very long absence with Wolverhampton second, should go close
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice at this venue for Joseph O'Brien early in his career (2019 and 2020); absent throughout 2023 and 2024; did well on his reappearance over an extended 1m at Wolverhampton last month, ran prominently all the way and beat all bar the favourite; strong contender if replicating that form.

runners_data.name: Methgal
runners_data.comment: C&D winner two weeks ago, capable of featuring again off a 4lb higher mark
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner two weeks ago, capable of featuring again off a 4lb higher mark.

runners_data.name: Royal County Glory
runners_data.comment: Has made the frame four times over 6f at this venue, needs just a little improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Solid 6f form at this venue under today's rider, notably a staying-on second in a nursery last November; fourth of 14 the following month after being squeezed for room two furlongs down; steps up in trip after a creditable third here last week on his first 2026 outing; could score with just a little improvement.

runners_data.name: Private Larry
runners_data.comment: In rear on handicap debut in 1m2f Navan, gelded since and now blinkered, makes no appeal
runners_data.spotlight: Moderate form in maidens over different trips on turf and AW; too keen and failed to stay when 50-1 for handicap debut in 1m2f Navan event 11 days ago; gelded since then, and now blinkered; makes no appeal.

runners_data.name: Queen Leila
runners_data.comment: Second over C&D in January three starts ago, well fancied then, worth a market check now
runners_data.spotlight: Second over C&D in January when well fancied to improve on her moderate 1m nursery form; reportedly got upset in the stalls when out of the money here in February, no apparent excuse last time; confidence dented by that run, but worth a market check.

runners_data.name: Cosmic Force
runners_data.comment: Not beaten far in sixth in his two runs here this year, needs to reverse form with Methgal
runners_data.spotlight: A 14-race maiden; placed only once (in a small-field race for George Boughey); best form in 2025 was in claimers; not beaten far in sixth over 6f here last month; same placing when 2 3/4l behind Methgal over C&D two weeks ago; place possibility.

runners_data.name: Brosna Green
runners_data.comment: Fair fourth in a 1m fillies' maiden here in January, hard to fancy on the balance of form
runners_data.spotlight: No success in 16 starts, 12 of those at this venue; fair fourth in a 1m fillies' maiden here in January; hard to fancy on the balance of form.

runners_data.name: Rodeeve
runners_data.comment: Placed only once on turf, soundly beaten twice at this venue, lightly raced last year
runners_data.spotlight: Placed only once on turf, soundly beaten twice at this venue; lightly raced last year, best of her three runs when seventh of 14 over 1m at Thurles.

runners_data.name: Caoilte
runners_data.comment: Hard to assess, the market may help to clarify his prospects on handicap debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Best of his three 1m outings at this venue came on debut; hard to assess, the market may help to clarify his prospects on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Straight Back Up
runners_data.comment: Unplaced in ten starts in Britain, poor form lately, jockey booking is the only positive
runners_data.spotlight: Unplaced in ten starts in Britain; has finished in front of only two of 21 rivals in his last three starts; jockey booking is the only positive

races.name: BAR 1 Betting Grand National Extra Places Maiden

runners_data.name: Amrum
runners_data.comment: Frankel colt who is a half-brother to top-class 6f-1m performer Siskin
runners_data.spotlight: Frankel colt who is a brother to 1m3f AW winner Byblos (RPR 89) and half-brother to top-class 6f-1m performer Siskin; lots to like on paper.

runners_data.name: Concaire
runners_data.comment: 17,500gns yearling; immediate fitting of headgear is rather unnerving
runners_data.spotlight: 17,500gns yearling; second foal; dam unraced sister to 1m2f Listed winner Extremis; immediate fitting of headgear is rather unnerving.

runners_data.name: Police Gazette
runners_data.comment: Cheekpieces fitted for debut and looks the yard's second string
runners_data.spotlight: Brother to US 5f/5.5f turf winner Stony Point; dam French/US 8.5f-9.5f winner who was Listed class; cheekpieces fitted for debut and looks the yard's second string.

runners_data.name: Threebiggulps
runners_data.comment: 5,000euros yearling; already gelded and wouldn't be the obvious answer
runners_data.spotlight: 5,000euros yearling; dam third 1m/1m2f AW (RPR 71), half-sister to winners Mammas Girl (7f Group 3) and Master Of War (6f 2yo Listed); already gelded and wouldn't be the obvious answer.

runners_data.name: Grand Premiere
runners_data.comment: 7-2 for his C&D debut in November and would probably have won had he been that bit wiser
runners_data.spotlight: $260,000USD yearling; only 7-2 for his C&D debut in November and would probably have won had he been that bit wiser; promising.

runners_data.name: Golddream
runners_data.comment: Fair debut effort here over 7f but this has the look of a stronger maiden
runners_data.spotlight: Ran okay for a 50-1 chance on his recent debut here over 7f, though never threatened the principals; held by County Carlow.

runners_data.name: Scientific
runners_data.comment: The ground was heavy when beaten 18l into seventh at the Curragh last month
runners_data.spotlight: 6-1 chance when beaten 18l at the Curragh last month (1m, heavy; held up); this different surface might well see him in a better light.

runners_data.name: Eniac
runners_data.comment: Third over 1m at Leopardstown and brings potential into his second campaign
runners_data.spotlight: Improved on his second run last season when third over 1m at Leopardstown (RPR 72); Irish Derby entrant who probably needs further than this but clearly brings potential into his second campaign.

runners_data.name: Grey Fable
runners_data.comment: Dual Chester winner in 2024; struggled last year and best watched now back from a break
runners_data.spotlight: Poor strike-rate of 2-34 and both wins at Chester over an extended 1m4f in July 2024; struggled last year and best watched now back from a break.

runners_data.name: Desert Friend
runners_data.comment: Recent course winner but he's 4lb higher and back in trip, which asks a bit of him
runners_data.spotlight: Had been finishing behind some of these but was sporting a tongue-tie for the first time on the AW when staying on best over 2m two weeks ago; he's 4lb higher and back in trip, which asks a bit of him.

runners_data.name: Slowdownbarney
runners_data.comment: Promising run two starts back and not a lot went right here two weeks ago
runners_data.spotlight: Only 1-23, the win coming over 1m6f at Wolverhampton; did go off favourite here two weeks ago and a lack of pace after starting slowly wasn't ideal (behind Desert Friend); had previously hinted at a return to form.

runners_data.name: Fine Print
runners_data.comment: Dual AW winner but lacks a run and hasn't been pulling up any trees over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice at Wolverhampton a year ago (1m6f/2m); lacks a run and hasn't been pulling up any trees over hurdles.

runners_data.name: Jawhary
runners_data.comment: Won twice over C&D during the winter and ran well three weeks ago in a higher grade
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over C&D during the winter and ran well three weeks ago in a higher grade; possible.

runners_data.name: Mephisto
runners_data.comment: Effective here and not badly treated, so could easily stage a revival
runners_data.spotlight: Completed a hat-trick in handicap hurdles last summer before losing his way; effective here and not badly treated, so could easily stage a revival.

runners_data.name: Palazzo Persico
runners_data.comment: Placed over 1m2f here last month; 1m too sharp last time; each-way claims if on his game
runners_data.spotlight: Three AW wins when trained by Ed Dunlop; 0-5 for current yard but was placed over 1m2f here last month; 1m too sharp last time; each-way claims if on his game.

runners_data.name: Celtic Druid
runners_data.comment: Back from a break to win over C&D a month ago when nicely on top late on; up 5lb
runners_data.spotlight: Back from a break to win over C&D a month ago when nicely on top late on; Sadhbh Tormey rides again off a 5lb higher mark; respected.

runners_data.name: Sarmiento Power
runners_data.comment: Only fifth to Desert Friend two runs back and was well beaten over 1m4f here last week
runners_data.spotlight: C&D win in September off 11lb lower; only fifth to Desert Friend two runs back and was well beaten over 1m4f here last week.

runners_data.name: Expert Analysis
runners_data.comment: 0-12; well held over 1m2f here in November when tried in a visor
runners_data.spotlight: 0-4 over hurdles and 0-8 on the Flat; well held over 1m2f here in November when tried in a visor.

runners_data.name: Al What
runners_data.comment: No wins in seven and beaten a good way in all her four handicaps (at about 1m2f)
runners_data.spotlight: No wins in seven and beaten a good way in all her four handicaps (at about 1m2f); off a reduced mark and cheekpieces are tried, but risky for now.

runners_data.name: Cameclose
runners_data.comment: Modest in maidens but by Camelot so longer trip could assist on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Posted modest RPRs in this three maidens (7f/1m) but this son of Camelot should at least approve of this longer trip on his handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Keepsgettingbetter
runners_data.comment: Responded well for pressure to win here over 1m on handicap debut; goes further
runners_data.spotlight: Nothing last season and didn't appear overly fancied for her handicap debut here three weeks ago (1m; 12-1), but she responded well for pressure to lead late on; raised 7lb but she is now at least a winner and promises to stay this far.

runners_data.name: Elm Creek
runners_data.comment: Beaten about 7l into third on handicap debut but appears to have found his level
runners_data.spotlight: First run of much note when third of 13 on handicap debut at Navan 11 days ago (1m2f, heavy; first-time cheekpieces); he was beaten over 7l but appears to have found his level.

runners_data.name: Ramair
runners_data.comment: Behind Keepsgettingbetter three weeks ago; has his work cut out to reverse those placings
runners_data.spotlight: Third on handicap debut here but didn't progress when behind Keepsgettingbetter three weeks ago; has his work cut out to reverse those placings.

runners_data.name: A Pretty Penny
runners_data.comment: 0-6 but ran better when only 2l away over 1m here four weeks ago and mark has dropped 3lb
runners_data.spotlight: 0-6 but ran better when only 2l away over 1m here four weeks ago and mark has dropped 3lb; weakened late on and does have further to travel this time.

runners_data.name: Musashi
runners_data.comment: Desperate last season but has been gelded and visor fitted for this handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Beat just a total of two horses in his maidens last season, at 1m, 7f and 6f; however, top trainer has had him gelded and fits a visor for handicap debut; market could be informative.

runners_data.name: Sea Of Dubka
runners_data.comment: Now goes into handicaps for a respected yard; makes sense to let the betting guide
runners_data.spotlight: Similar profile to Musashi in that she showed precious little last season (at about 1m) but now goes into handicaps for a respected yard; makes sense to let the betting guide.
